author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

- **Agent reply can carry a layout.** The system prompt adds an optional `ui` field to the reply JSON: a [json-render](https://json-render.dev/docs/api/shadcn) spec limited to `Card`, `Stack`, `Text`, `Table` and `Alert`. Replies that list two or more medications, allergies, appointments, results or episodes come back as a table. `ui` is `null` for symptoms, general questions and every S1 reply.
- **API.** `parse_agent_reply` keeps `ui` in the turn metadata next to `severity` and `confidence`. Metadata is already spread onto the wire turn, so nothing else changes on the wire.
- **UI.** A new `ReplyUI` (`components/chat/reply-ui.tsx`) validates the spec against a catalog of exactly those five types and renders it through `@json-render/shadcn`. If the spec doesn't validate, the turn shows its text as before. Tailwind is pointed at json-render's dist with `@source`, so its classes get generated.
- **Model.** The agent moves from `openai/gpt-4o-mini` to `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`. `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are updated to match.

## Test plan

- [x] API: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (167 passed). Adds a test that `ui` is carried with the turn.
- [x] UI: `lint`, `format:check`, `tsc --noEmit`, `vitest` (54 passed). Adds `reply-ui.test.tsx`: a valid spec renders a table, and a type outside the catalog falls back to the text.
- [ ] Manual: ask "what medications am I on?" and confirm the reply renders as a table.
